arxiv-2109-02565.title: Self-similar solutions for the Muskat equation
arxiv-2109-02565.creator: Eduardo García-Juárez †, Javier Gómez-Serrano ‡, Huy Q. Nguyen ∗, Benoît Pausader §
arxiv-2109-02565.description: Abstract . We show the existence of self-similar solutions for the Muskat equation. These solutions are parameterized by 0 < s ≪ 1 0<s\ll 1 ; they are exact corners of slope s s at t = 0 t=0 and become smooth in x x for t > 0 t>0 . 1. Introduction 1.1.

arxiv-2112-09160.title: Meteorites and the RNA World: Synthesis of Nucleobases in Carbonaceous Planetesimals and the Role of Initial Volatile Content
arxiv-2112-09160.creator: Klaus Paschek, Dmitry A. Semenov, Ben K. D. Pearce, Kevin Lange, Thomas K. Henning, Ralph E. Pudritz
arxiv-2112-09160.description: Abstract Prebiotic molecules, fundamental building blocks for the origin of life, have been found in carbonaceous chondrites. The exogenous delivery of these organic molecules onto the Hadean Earth could have sparked the polymerization of the first RNA molecules in Darwinian ponds during wet-dry cycles.

arxiv-2112-12403.title: A Hessian Geometric Structure of Chemical Thermodynamic Systems with Stoichiometric Constraints
arxiv-2112-12403.creator: Yuki Sughiyama, Dimitri Loutchko, Atsushi Kamimura and Tetsuya J. Kobayashi
arxiv-2112-12403.description: Abstract We establish a Hessian geometric structure in chemical thermodynamics which describes chemical reaction networks (CRNs) with equilibrium states. In our setup, the ideal gas assumption and mass action kinetics are not required. The existence and uniqueness condition of the equilibrium state is derived by using the Legendre duality inherent to the Hessian structure.

arxiv-2209-01123.title: Direct products of free groups in Aut ⁡ ( F N ) {\rm{Aut}}(F_{N})
arxiv-2209-01123.creator: Martin R. Bridson, Richard D. Wade
arxiv-2209-01123.description: Abstract We give a complete description of the embeddings of direct products of nonabelian free groups into Aut ⁡ ( F N ) {\rm{Aut}}(F_{N}) and Out ⁡ ( F N ) {\rm{Out}}(F_{N}) when the number of direct factors is maximal.

arxiv-2305-02008.title: Zenseact Open Dataset: A large-scale and diverse multimodal dataset for autonomous driving
arxiv-2305-02008.creator: Mina Alibeigi, William Ljungbergh, Adam Tonderski Georg Hess, Adam Lilja, Carl Lindström, Daria Motorniuk, Junsheng Fu, Jenny Widahl, Christoffer PeterssonZenseact first.last@zenseact.com
arxiv-2305-02008.description: Abstract Existing datasets for autonomous driving (AD) often lack diversity and long-range capabilities, focusing instead on 360 ° \mathrm{\SIUnitSymbolDegree} perception and temporal reasoning. To address this gap, we introduce Zenseact Open Dataset (ZOD), a large-scale and diverse multimodal dataset collected over two years in various European countries, covering an area 9 × \times that of existing datasets.

arxiv-2306-17016.title: On the suitability of rigorous coupled-wave analysis for fast optical force simulations Journal: \JOPT
arxiv-2306-17016.creator: Bo Gao, Henkjan Gersen, Simon Hanna
arxiv-2306-17016.description: Abstract Optical force responses underpin nanophotonic actuator design, which requires a large number of force simulations to optimize structures. Commonly used computation methods, such as the finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) method, are resource intensive and require large amounts of calculation time when multiple structures need to be compared during optimization.

arxiv-2404-13549.title: Interference of high-order perfect optical vortex beams Journal: opticajournal
arxiv-2404-13549.creator: Bikash K. Das, C. Granados, M. Krüger, M. F. Ciappina
arxiv-2404-13549.description: Abstract We investigate the interference of high-order perfect optical vortex (POV) beams with different topological charges. Through numerical simulations, we reveal a remarkable phenomenon: keeping the beam width, and beam radius fixed while changing the topological charge, the splitting of the composite POV beam into two distinct individual perfect vortices occurs exactly at the same inter-axial separation.

arxiv-2508-08953.title: Listen through the Sound: Generative Speech Restoration Leveraging Acoustic Context Representation
arxiv-2508-08953.creator: Soo-Whan, Min-Seok
arxiv-2508-08953.description: Abstract This paper introduces a novel approach to speech restoration by integrating a context-related conditioning strategy. Specifically, we employ the diffusion-based generative restoration model, UNIVERSE++, as a backbone to evaluate the effectiveness of contextual representations. We incorporate acoustic context embeddings extracted from the CLAP model, which capture the environmental attributes of input audio.

arxiv-2601-08340.title: Pursuing transparency: how research organizations in Germany collect data on publication costs
arxiv-2601-08340.creator: Dorothea Strecker, Heinz Pampel, Jonas Höfting
arxiv-2601-08340.description: Abstract Abstract This article presents the results of a survey conducted in 2024 among research performing organizations (RPOs) in Germany on how they collect data on publication costs. Of the 583 invitees, 258 (44.3%) completed the questionnaire. This survey is the first comprehensive study on the recording of publication costs at RPOs in Germany.

arxiv-2602-17440.title: A Programmable Linear Optical Quantum Reservoir with Measurement Feedback for Time Series Analysis
arxiv-2602-17440.creator: Çağın Ekici
arxiv-2602-17440.description: Abstract Feedback-driven quantum reservoir computing has so far been studied primarily in gate-based architectures, motivating alternative scalable, hardware-friendly physical platforms. Here we investigate a linear-optical quantum reservoir architecture for time-series processing based on multiphoton interference in a reconfigurable interferometer network equipped with threshold detectors and measurement-conditioned feedback.

pmc-10740867.title: Canine Pyothorax: Comparison of Culture and Susceptibility Results to the BSAVA PROTECT ME Poster and Other Published Recommended Antimicrobial Use Guidelines

pmc-10740867.description: Simple SummaryPyothorax, a collection of pus in the pleural cavity (space between the lung and the inner surface of the chest wall), can be caused by penetrating injuries, migrating plant material, ruptured lung abscess, the spread of infection from pneumonia, or by way of the bloodstream.

pmc-11356850.title: Advances in Aptamer-Based Biosensors for the Detection of Foodborne Mycotoxins
pmc-11356850.creator: Yangyang Li, Dan Zhang, Xiaoyuan Zeng, Cheng Liu, Yan Wu, Cuicui Fu
pmc-11356850.description: Foodborne mycotoxins (FBMTs) are toxins produced by food itself or during processing and transportation that pose an enormous threat to public health security. However, traditional instrumental and chemical methods for detecting toxins have shortcomings, such as high operational difficulty, time consumption, and high cost, that limit their large-scale applications.

pmc-11548712.title: Needs Companion: A Novel Approach to Continuous User Needs Sensing Using Virtual Agents and Large Language Models
pmc-11548712.creator: Takuya Nakata, Masahide Nakamura, Sinan Chen, Sachio Saiki
pmc-11548712.description: In today’s world, services are essential in daily life, and identifying each person’s unique needs is key to creating a human-centered society. Traditional research has used machine learning to recommend services based on user behavior logs without directly detecting individual needs.

pmc-12472191.title: The Role of Dietary Supplements in Modulating Menopause Onset: A Comprehensive Analysis of Nutritional and Lifestyle Influences on Menopause Timing
pmc-12472191.creator: Shekhinamary Jebaraj, Valentine Nlebedim, Megumi Haruna, Wojciech Koch
pmc-12472191.description: Background: The age at natural menopause (ANM) has a significant impact on women’s health later in life, although the contribution of changeable dietary and lifestyle factors remains uncertain. Methods: We examined data from 3566 participants in the UK Women’s Cohort Study, assessing their baseline use of dietary supplements and lifestyle habits.

pmc-12593258.title: Prostate cancer statistics, 2025
pmc-12593258.creator: Tyler B Kratzer, Natalia Mazzitelli, Jessica Star, William L Dahut, Ahmedin Jemal, Rebecca L Siegel
pmc-12593258.description: Prostate cancer is the most common cancer among men in the United States, and the incidence of advanced disease is increasing rapidly. This article provides an overview of prostate cancer occurrence using population‐based incidence and mortality data from the National Cancer Institute and the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.

pmc-12646598.title: Identification of Acute Respiratory Failure Phenotypes With Electronic Health Record Data
pmc-12646598.creator: Charles R. Terry, Daniel L. Brinton, Katie G. Kirchoff, Andrew J. Goodwin, Dee W. Ford

pmc-13083811.title: Digital Violations: Technology-Facilitated Sexual Violence in Canadian Sport
pmc-13083811.creator: Andrea Quinlan, Curtis Fogel, Walter S DeKeseredy, Kim Dubé
pmc-13083811.description: Through an analysis of 91 publicly reported legal cases of technology-facilitated sexual violence against women and children in Canadian sport, this paper examines the role that digital technologies play in sexual violence in sport and the criminal legal response to it.

pmc-13411856.title: The Big Picture: 26 Years of Longitudinal Findings About Health Promotion and Quality of Life in Multiple Sclerosis
pmc-13411856.creator: Alexa M. Stuifbergen, Heather Becker
pmc-13411856.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background/Objectives: In recent decades, health care for those living with chronic and disabling conditions has expanded beyond symptom and disease management to include efforts to promote health and quality of life. This narrative review synthesizes insights from a 26-year longitudinal study examining health promotion and quality of life among persons living with the chronic and disabling condition of multiple sclerosis (MS). Methods: The longitudinal study, launched in 1999, included a sample of 621 community-residing persons with MS.

pmc-13476532.title: Prevalence and genetic characterization of Toxoplasma gondii in retail meats from fresh Markets in Songkhla Province, Thailand
pmc-13476532.creator: Siriluk Kaewmanee, Domechai Kaewnoi, Ketsarin Kamyingkird, Ruttayaporn Ngasaman
pmc-13476532.description: Toxoplasma gondii is a significant foodborne protozoon responsible for human toxoplasmosis, typically transmitted via undercooked meat, contaminated water, or contact with oocysts in cat feces. This study aimed to evaluate the prevalence and genetic diversity of T. gondii in retail meats within Songkhla province to assess public health risks.

pmc-13574285.title: Symptomatic reactive hypoglycemia is highly prevalent post-esophagectomy
pmc-13574285.creator: Mistura A Kareem, Katie Byrne, Niamh Ni Mhaoinigh, Paul Healy, Jane Fagan, Jessie A Elliott, Michelle Fanning, Suzanne L Doyle, John V Reynolds, Claire L Donohoe
pmc-13574285.description: Summary Impaired long-term health-related quality of life (HRQL) is a growing concern for disease-free survivors post-esophagectomy. Post-prandial discomfort, neuroglycopenic symptoms, and dumping are common and often linked to reactive hypoglycemia (RH), a condition not yet prospectively studied in this cohort.

pmc-13603488.title: Systemic Antibiotics as Adjuncts in Periodontal Therapy for Stage III and Stage IV Periodontitis: An Umbrella Review Aligned with the 2018 World Workshop Classification, with AMSTAR-2 Critical Appraisal

pmc-13603488.description: Introduction: Severe periodontitis, corresponding to Stage III and Stage IV disease according to the 2018 World Workshop classification, represents a substantial global health burden.
